description: SO(9) BMN Q-cohomology on SU(3)_R highest-weight vectors: ALL dominant columns lam = (q1>=q2>=q3>=0) with j = 2(q1+q2+q3) <= 20 and every nonempty 2J (66 columns, 234 sectors). One JSON line per sector, fortuity.hwcoh.run_sectors format: m = exact hw multiplicity, r_up = rank of Q from 2J to 2J+1, grav = multi-graviton hw classes modulo exact, check = self-check (rank of the hw vectors at the chosen functionals = m). The irrep lam occurs in the cohomology at 2J = n with multiplicity h = m_n - r_up(n-1) - r_up(n); non-graviton = h - grav. Result: 345 classes (per j = 4..20: 1, 1, 4, 5, 13, 21, 47, 85, 168), all multi-graviton (h = grav in every sector): no fortuitous class below the first SO(9)/USp(8) index difference at j = 22 (R-006). T-025.
computed_by: Fortuity collaboration (Claude agent), NYU Torch (partition cs, account ${ACCOUNT})
code: code/fortuity/hwcoh (run_sectors, ENGINE=par, group='SO_odd'); exact multiplicities from hwcoh.dims.partition_dims_nf (all 2J); MKL build of the ffblas kernel
conventions: D-006 BMN conventions; so(9) letters as random antisymmetric 9x9 matrices over F_p; graviton generators u_n, v_n, w_n up to n = 10 (GEN_NMAX=10; highest Casimir degree 8).
command: scripts/bmn/so-odd-thresholds: sbatch dims.sbatch 4 22; sbatch --array=1-42 col.sbatch with TASKS=tasks_so9.txt (each line: GROUP=SO_odd GEN_NMAX=10 ENGINE=par python -m fortuity.hwcoh.run_sectors 4 dims_so9_j22.pkl OUT COLUMNS); jobs 18887924, 18887926
checked: (i) per-sector self-check passed in all 234 sectors; (ii) Euler characteristic = exact refined BMN index (fortuity.bmn.groupindex, via scripts/bmn/so-usp-g2-scans/euler_check.py) in all 66 columns; (iii) positive control in the same run: column (5,3,3) at j = 22 reproduces R-006 and an independent column run (m = 131/442/664/665/404/114/3, one non-graviton class at 2J = 1; so9_hw_cohomology_533_j22_control.jsonl); (iv) exact dims: 1785 entries to j = 22, as in an independent run. Single seed: a random evaluation can only underestimate ranks, which can create spurious non-graviton classes but never hide one, so a null result needs no second seed.
